def: to breeze, i.e. blow up fresh (as the wind)

occurrences.text: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.

Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
